vtable.extent_evidence: config/arm9/overlays/ov006/relocs.txt has a relocated word at every 4-byte address from 0x0213e39c through 0x0213e428 inclusive -- 36 words -- and the next relocated word is 0x0213e444, which is the typeinfo header of _ZTV19dScMgSingle3DBase_c (symbol at 0x0213e448). With the 8-byte header the storage runs 0x0213e394..0x0213e42c = 0x98 bytes. mwccarm 2004/b56 emits a 0x98 .data section for this symbol, which is the same number from the compiler's side. Reading the extent as (next symbols.txt row 0x0213e42c) - (symbol 0x0213e39c) = 0x90 UNDER-reports it, because the _ZTV symbol is the ADDRESS POINT and not the storage start.

destructor.evidence: ov006 lays D1 at 0x0210788c and D0 at 0x02107920, and no D2 exists anywhere in the image. In mwccarm 2004/b56 an inline in-class destructor emits D1 then D0, which is this order; an out-of-line definition emits D2, D0, D1. The pair is therefore inside the licensed run and the TU promotes whole. Slots 16 and 17 of the class vtable are the only references to either address in config/.

unproven: Element type of the 5 x 0x34 array at 0x51a8: __destroy_arr is called with func_ov006_021079c8 as the element destructor and that body is empty, so the elements have no ROM RTTI identity. The header keeps them as raw bytes.

Identity of the 0x270-byte subobject at 0x4f38: it is constructed by func_ov006_020c1d80 and destroyed by func_ov006_020c1c64, both shared with five sibling minigame scenes, but neither carries a class name.

The two 0x50-byte spans at 0x531c and 0x536c are Models by construction (_ZN5ModelC1Ev in the factory) and destruction (_ZN5ModelD1Ev in the destructor), but they are still spelled as raw bytes because the ROM destructor interleaves the array and table teardown between them, which Itanium auto-destruction of typed members cannot reproduce.
0x52ac..0x531c (0x70 bytes) is reached only through raw-offset helper calls (func_ov006_02107b70, func_ov006_02108524, func_ov006_02107d80, func_ov006_021085c0) and has no named field.

Whether any of the 32 non-virtual functions in this run had external linkage in the original source: none is referenced from outside 0x0210788c..0x0210a400, and func_ov006_0210858c and func_ov006_02109aa0 were referenced ONLY by their sibling shards, but adjacency does not prove static versus external linkage.
